Class Deck

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.gc49.server.model.CardBoard.Deck
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Deck extends Object implements Serializable
Manages the creation, shuffling, and dealing of all cards in the game.

The Deck class is responsible for loading card data from JSON files, instantiating the correct Java objects based on the card types, grouping them by Era, shuffling them, and providing them to the game during execution. It manages two distinct decks: the Tribe deck (characters and events) and the Building deck.

    • Deck

      public Deck(Game game)
      Constructs and initializes a fully populated Deck for a specific game.

      This constructor triggers the JSON parsing and deck building process for both the Tribe and Building decks, tailoring the available cards to the specific number of players in the game.

      Parameters:
      game - the Game instance this deck belongs to
